capabilities: Shorten file-name labels in the graph, with full names on hover
Generate one hub note per topic so notes cluster by meaning
Apply a calm layout that stops the graph simulation once nodes settle
Switch between Dopamine, Quiet, and color-blindness palettes
Focus on a single topic in a local graph and list notes without a topic
extras: Uses parts of Obsidian outside the public API, so short labels and the still graph may break on Obsidian updates. Applying the calm layout overwrites existing graph filters, groups, and forces. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Tested on Obsidian 1.14.4 desktop only.
intentEvidence: This plugin keeps the graph you already have and makes it calm enough to think with.
motivation: The author writes: "I needed a better way to organize my second brain... Nothing out there was built for a brain that works like mine."
problem: The core graph view renders full file names, keeps moving, and clusters by folder, turning into a wall of text past a few hundred notes.
summary: Graph view add-on that makes the Obsidian graph calmer with short labels, topic hub notes, a still layout, and Dopamine or Quiet palettes.
